script_text: Gemini, this week Mercury retrograde in your 12th House is about to shake everything you thought you knew. Early week, the Sun in your 1st House squares Pluto, bringing intense confrontations that force you to shed old identities — Tuesday is the hardest day as Mercury opposes Jupiter, muddying every conversation. Mid-week, the Taurus Moon trines your natal Venus on Wednesday, unlocking a sudden romantic spark or creative breakthrough that catches you completely off guard. Late week, Mars enters your 7th House, igniting passion in relationships but also triggering power struggles with partners — Friday demands patience. Saturday brings a beautiful Venus sextile to your ruler Mercury, perfect for heartfelt talks. Your best day is Wednesday because the Moon trines Venus, flooding you with charm and magnetic energy. Your worst day is Tuesday due to the Mercury-Jupiter opposition, which amplifies miscommunication and false promises. This week, write down every dream you have — Mercury retrograde in your 12th House is sending coded messages through your subconscious. Follow for daily updates.
